alternatives.option: Keep full gate definitions in SessionStart prompt alongside CLAUDE.md injection
alternatives.reason_rejected: ~400 tokens of duplication every session. CLAUDE.md already carries the authoritative content; the prompt just needs a pointer.

context: The 3-gate content was duplicated ~4 times across SessionStart prompt, CLAUDE.md template, MCP instructions, and skills. Per Anthropic's skill best practices, each layer should serve a distinct purpose without repeating content.
rationale: CLAUDE.md is the single source of truth for gate definitions (persistent, survives context compression). SessionStart prompt is now a 40-token pointer to CLAUDE.md. Skills focus on HOW-TO workflows with third-person descriptions and when-to-use triggers for discovery. MCP instructions remain as condensed fallback for non-plugin clients.
summary: Layered instruction architecture: CLAUDE.md as authority, lean SessionStart prompt, third-person skill descriptions
